Process documents with spaCy (deprecated)

Source: R/spacy_parse.R
process_document.Rd

This function is deprecated, and will be removed in a future version of spacyr, together with the get-functions that read its result. It gives a warning on every call. Use spacy_parse() instead, which returns all the results in one data.frame.

process_document() parses documents with spaCy and returns a handle on the parsed documents, which are kept in Python until the handle is garbage collected. They are not affected by later calls to other spacyr functions. The handle does not keep the language model: spacy_finalize() frees it as usual.

process_document(x, multithread, n_process = 1L, batch_size = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

a character object or a quanteda corpus

multithread

deprecated; see spacy_parse()

n_process, batch_size

passed to spaCy's nlp.pipe(); see spacy_parse()

...

not used

Value

an object of class spacy_out, for the get-functions

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spacy_initialize()
txt <- c(text1 = "This is the first sentence.\nHere is the second sentence.",
         text2 = "This is the second document.")
# instead of process_document() and get_tokens():
spacy_parse(txt)$token
} # }
